message: FIX-003 done. server.mjs: isHumanTask computed in finalizeTicket() from Recommended model (/^human/i after trim), exposed in GET /api/tickets; POST /api/execute rejects human tickets 422 before runner/model/dependency checks; new POST /api/mark-human-done (ticket, note required, author default human) reuses appendLedgerEntry() for a completed entry; foldLedger() gained event:note + optional resultingState support for transparent ledger corrections. index.html: buildCard() renders a tarea humana - no ejecutable badge instead of runner-select/model-select/Execute for isHumanTask tickets; ver log/comentarios links untouched. Verification evidence: node --check server.mjs OK; index.html inline script extracted + new Function() OK; server restarted on :4570; GET /api/tickets shows DIS-001/002/003 isHumanTask:true and DIS-001 rawState pending; POST /api/execute DIS-001 -> HTTP 422 {isHumanTask:true, error mentions mark progress manually in roadmap-status.md}; POST /api/execute INF-002 -> HTTP 412 incomplete dependency INF-001 (no isHumanTask flag present, confirms unaffected normal ticket flow, avoided actually launching a long-running process); POST /api/mark-human-done rejects non-human ticket with 422 and missing note with 400 (did not actually mark DIS-001/003 done, out of scope).
